desc_en: We compare Apple SpeechAnalyzer API with OpenAI Whisper on accuracy, speed, price, and privacy to help developers pick the right STT stack in 2026.
desc_zh: 我们对比苹果全新SpeechAnalyzer API与OpenAI Whisper，从准确率、速度、价格和隐私四个维度帮助开发者选择。
author: AI Tool Hub Editorial

faq.q: Is Apple SpeechAnalyzer a cloud API or does it run on device?
faq.a: By default SpeechAnalyzer runs fully on device using the Apple Neural Engine. Apple also offers an opt-in cloud fallback for long-form or high-noise audio, but it must be enabled explicitly.

faq.q: Can SpeechAnalyzer replace Whisper for cross-platform apps?
faq.a: Not yet. SpeechAnalyzer only ships on Apple operating systems, so apps supporting Android, Windows, Linux, or the web will still need Whisper or another cross-platform engine for non-Apple clients.

faq.q: Is SpeechAnalyzer free for commercial use?
faq.a: The on-device API is included with the standard Apple SDK and has no per-minute fees or usage caps for App Store apps. The cloud fallback, when it launches, will have separate metered pricing.
